repositories.name: rea
repositories.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repositories.summary: REA 是一个基于 MCP 的逆向工程工具，让 AI 代理分析二进制、应用与运行时行为，并给出带证据的结论。

repositories.name: claude-plugins-official
repositories.description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
repositories.summary: 这是 Anthropic 维护的 Claude Code 插件目录，收录官方与第三方高质量插件，供用户浏览和安装。

repositories.name: scientific-agent-skills
repositories.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 250,000+ scientists worldwide. 177 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
repositories.summary: 这是一个面向科研的 AI 智能体技能库，提供 177 个经校验的科学技能和 100 多个生物、化学、医学与药物发现数据库，让 AI 编程助手能执行科研任务。

repositories.name: caveman
repositories.description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick. Viral skill + proxy for coding agents that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like a caveman.
repositories.summary: Caveman 是一个用 Go 编写的编码代理代理与技能工具，通过压缩输入输出和自动选模型，减少 AI 编程代理的 token 消耗与费用。

repositories.name: VoiceStudio
repositories.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
repositories.summary: VoiceStudio 是一个完全本地运行的开源语音工具，支持语音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，覆盖 646 种语言。

repositories.name: superpowers
repositories.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repositories.summary: Superpowers 是一套面向编码智能体的软件开发方法论，由可组合技能和初始指令构成，让智能体按流程完成开发任务。

repositories.name: ruflo
repositories.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
repositories.summary: Ruflo 是面向 Claude Code 和 Codex 的智能体元框架，用于部署多智能体集群、协调自动化工作流并构建对话式 AI 系统。

repositories.name: context-mode
repositories.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
repositories.summary: Context Mode 是一个面向 AI 编程代理的 MCP 服务器，通过沙箱隔离工具输出、持久化会话记忆和路由规则来优化上下文窗口占用。

repositories.name: ghidra
repositories.description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
repositories.summary: Ghidra 是由美国国家安全局开发的软件逆向工程框架，提供反汇编、反编译、绘图和脚本等工具，用于分析多平台的编译代码。

repositories.name: ECC
repositories.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repositories.summary: ECC 是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程代理的性能优化系统，提供技能、记忆、安全与先研究后开发的工程化工具链。

repositories.name: tokenspeed
repositories.description: TokenSpeed is a speed-of-light LLM inference engine.
repositories.summary: TokenSpeed 是一个面向智能体工作负载的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，用 Python 编写，兼顾 TensorRT-LLM 级性能与 vLLM 级易用性。

repositories.name: xerj
repositories.description: XERJ is the new way for AI to search data. Its autoindex capability activates agents to know your data without the token waste of grep and sed. One command indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs for search, RAG, security audits and agent memory, using 40x fewer tokens than grep. Elasticsearch compatible, so existing clients just work.
repositories.summary: XERJ 是一个用 Rust 编写的本地 AI 搜索工具，可自动索引代码、文档、日志和 PDF，供智能体检索使用，并兼容 Elasticsearch API。
